description: Crop an image to a pixel box (x, y, width, height) or to an aspect ratio (1:1, 4:5, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, "W:H" or a number), taking the largest centred region (or aligned to an edge with `position`). Boxes are kept inside the image. Output JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF, name <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-resize/

format.description: Output format. "keep" = same as the input when it is JPEG/PNG/WebP (else PNG). Default keep.

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

position.description: Where the ratio crop sits. Default center (the website default).

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF (ignored for PNG). Default 90, same as the website.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio as "W:H" (e.g. "1:1", "4:5", "3:2", "16:9", "9:16"), a number (width/height), "orig" or "free".

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

x.description: Left edge of the crop box (pixels). Use with y, width, height.

y.description: Top edge of the crop box (pixels).

name: image_crop
title: Crop image
